# RoarTech Inc.

RoarTech Inc. is a software development consulting firm specializing in Cloud Migration and Enterprise Governance, founded in 2014. 
We integrate DevSecOps with cloud migration best practices tailored to federal and commercial standards.

## Core Capabilities
- Cloud Technology: AWS, Azure, GCP, and hybrid-multi-cloud solutions.
- Next-Generation Data and Analytics: Machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) data visualization.
- Reporting and Metrics: Identifying strengths, weaknesses, and future possibilities for new software.
- DevSecOps: CI/CD automation tools.
- Enterprise Architecture: EA best practices and standards for secure cloud solutions.
- Governance Regulatory and Compliance: End-to-end governance structures, process functions, standardization, and tech council.

## Key Clients & Past Performance
- Department of Veterans Affairs (VA)
- T&T Consulting
- US Marine Corps
- Department of State (DoS)
- Department of Education
- USAID
- General Services Administration (GSA)
- DOD USAF
